stemMd: Room areas are 12, 14, 14, 18 and 22 square metres. What is their mean area?
explanationMd: The areas sum to 80 square metres. Divide by five rooms to get a mean of 16 square metres.

distractorRationale.a: This is the median and mode, not mean.
distractorRationale.d: This is the total before division.
distractorRationale.c: This does not equal the total divided by five.
distractorRationale.e: This is one listed value rather than the average.
